comment: The character creator: questions about the life before the field woke. Each answer leans the character; the generator (game/scripts/creation.gd) adds the leans up. A people or bloodline is suggested and the player confirms or picks another.

questions.ask: Before your field woke, where was home?

answers.text: Columbia, under the marshals' bells. Every quarrel there goes to court.
answers.why: you grew up in Columbia

answers.text: Cahokia, on the river. The current decides, and you learn to read it.
answers.why: you grew up on the river at Cahokia

answers.text: Lunden, in the fog under the airship docks.
answers.why: you grew up in Lunden's fog

answers.text: Nowhere for long: a station on the line, between the cities.
answers.why: you grew up on the line itself

questions.ask: What did the old ones say about your blood?

answers.text: Nothing. We're ordinary, as far as anyone knows.
answers.why: your family called itself ordinary

answers.text: That we are one of the peoples. We carry it together.
answers.why: your people carry it together

answers.text: That a house would come looking for me one day.
answers.why: a house was always going to come for you

answers.text: Nobody said. I never knew them.
answers.why: you never knew your blood

questions.ask: Something comes to the door at night. What do you do?

answers.why: you stood in the doorway

answers.text: Take the gun down from the wall.
answers.why: you went for the gun

answers.text: Set the straw alight between us.
answers.why: you set the straw alight

answers.text: Watch it, and wait for its mistake.
answers.why: you waited for its mistake

answers.text: Call to it, so it looks at me and not at them.
answers.why: you made it look at you

answers.text: Pull the shelves across the door.
answers.why: you barred the door with what was to hand

questions.ask: What do you want beside you in the dark?

answers.why: you wanted something that watches from above

answers.text: Something that stands between me and harm.
answers.why: you wanted something to stand between you and harm
you wanted something you could hold
you wanted something that was never alive
you wanted something with a voice
you wanted something that burns
you wanted something that remembers
you wanted something that owes you

questions.ask: What would you never do, even to save your own life?

answers.text: Strike the same one twice with everything I have.
answers.why: you would never strike one foe twice with everything
you would never fight for yourself alone

answers.text: Raise a hand without saying why.
answers.why: you would never strike in silence
there is nothing you would not do

questions.ask: What would you pay, for the power to keep them safe?

answers.why: you would pay in blood

answers.text: Everything I have left in me.
answers.why: you would pay everything you had left

answers.text: The weapon in my hand, after.
answers.why: you would give up your weapon after

answers.text: A mark on me, forever, where anyone can see.
answers.why: you would take a scar for it
you think power should not cost

questions.ask: When are you at your best?

answers.why: you are best after you have been hit

answers.text: When it's nearly over, and I'm still standing.
answers.why: you are best when it is nearly over

answers.text: When I've caught the first blow clean.
answers.why: you are best once you have caught the first blow

answers.text: When I've named what I'm fighting, out loud.
answers.why: you are best once you have named the foe

answers.text: Fresh, before anything has gone wrong.
answers.why: you are best fresh

questions.ask: What would your friends call you, if they were honest?

answers.why: your friends call you immovable
your friends call you quick
your friends call you changeable
your friends call you watchful
your friends call you persuasive
your friends call you handy

questions.ask: In a fight, you would rather...

answers.text: Hit hard, once, and be done.
answers.why: you would rather hit hard once
you would rather keep your distance

answers.text: Never let it land a blow.
answers.why: you would rather it never land a blow
you would rather outlast it
you would rather be close
deep water frightens you
the open sun frightens you
fire frightens you
the cold frightens you
being held down frightens you

answers.text: Being seen for what I am.
answers.why: being seen for what you are frightens you
being alone frightens you
the dark between the stars frightens you
nothing with a name frightens you
